page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.2xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized instance driven by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a clock frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance features 8 dedicated vCPUs spanning 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core under KVM hypervisor management. It provides a cache hierarchy consisting of 48 KB L1d, 1 MB L2, and 48 MB L3 cache per core cluster. Hardware vector instructions include AVX-512 with VNNI support, alongside cryptographic acceleration features such as AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

Configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, the instance maintains a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM allocation ratio (2.0 GB per vCPU). The instance includes no attached local storage, relying on external network-attached volumes, while offering a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. Synthetic benchmarks position processor performance within the middle 50% percentile across tests, recording a single-core stress-ng score of 1842.09 and a multi-core score of 7750.38. Geekbench testing yields 1567.0 single-core and 5804.0 multi-core scores, while PassMark CPU evaluations reach 11317.96 points.

Memory performance demonstrates 58.32 GB/sec uncached read and 41.33 GB/sec uncached write bandwidth. In web and application layer testing, the server achieves a static web serving throughput of 11.46 GB/sec and handles up to 7.83 million Redis SET operations per second. The compute-focused resource allocation offers strong execution density for CPU-bound workloads such as web serving, software compilation, and light database caching. However, the lack of local NVMe storage requires dependence on network storage, and the limited memory per core restricts suitability for memory-intensive data analytics.
